Every diagram on this site is drawn by the crate `modelspec-diagram` from a program's verified Tensor IR, the IR `modelspec ir --stage tensor` prints, and regenerated by `modelspec-docs` on every change, so a diagram cannot drift from the program it shows (DESIGN.md § 13).

- [Atoms](./atoms.mdx): every glyph, one per Tensor IR operation and one per composite, stage and endpoint, grouped by operator family, with the source name of each operator and the glyph of its gradient op.
- [Layers](./layers.mdx): composed blocks, from a dense layer to self-attention, each a small model whose forward is the block, with its source and its diagram.
- [Two layers with relu](../examples/two-layer-relu.mdx): the first example shown with its diagram beside its code.

Modules and pipelines join this section as they land.
